# 3ware Ltd .github repository

This repository hosts the README displayed on the [3ware GitHub organisation page](../profile/README.md) and the default community health files shared across all 3ware repositories.

## Contributing

1. Open a pull request using the [pull request template](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md).
2. Changes are reviewed by `@3ware/repo-maintainers`, as defined in [CODEOWNERS](CODEOWNERS).
3. Run [Trunk](https://trunk.io/) locally to lint your changes before pushing.

## Security

To report a vulnerability, follow the [security policy](SECURITY.md).

## More Information

Visit [www.3ware.co.uk](https://www.3ware.co.uk/) to learn more about 3ware and our services.
